blocks.text: Isomerism organic compounds ki aik aham khoobi hai.

blocks.title: Isomerism
blocks.text: Do ya zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik hi ho magar structural formulas aur properties alag hon, isomers kehlate hain, aur is cheez ko isomerism kehte hain.
Compound ka structural formula batata hai ke us mein atoms aur bonds kis tarteeb mein lage hain.

Sab se saada hydrocarbon jis ke structural isomers hain, butane (C₄H₁₀) hai. Butane ya alkane family ke bare hydrocarbons ke structural formulas dekhein to pata chalta hai ke molecule ke atoms ko aik se zyada tarah lagaya ja sakta hai aur har tarah mein tamam valencies (bond banane ki salahiyat) poori hoti hain. Yani aik hi molecular formula ki do ya zyada alag tarteebein ho sakti hain. Maslan chlorobutane molecule ki do alag tarteebein hain:

Tajurbe se bhi is ki tasdeeq hoti hai: C₄H₉Cl formula wale do compounds hain jin ki physical properties alag hain. Teen se zyada carbon atoms wale compounds mein isomerism na sirf mumkin balki aam hai. Hydrocarbon mein carbon atoms barhne ke saath mumkin isomers ki tadaad bohat tezi se barhti hai. Paanch carbon wale compound pentane ke teen isomers hain.

blocks.prompt: Methane, ethane ya propane ka koi structural isomer kyun nahi, jabke butane ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Aik, do ya teen carbons ko chain mein jorne ka sirf aik tareeqa hai, is liye sirf aik structure banta hai. Chaar carbons mein chautha carbon teen carbon wali chain ke sire se (butane) ya beech wale carbon se (2-methylpropane) jur sakta hai; is tarah C₄H₁₀ ke do alag compounds bante hain.

items: Isomers: aik molecular formula, alag structural formula aur properties; sab se pehle butane C₄H₁₀ mein; C₄H₉Cl ke 1- aur 2-chlorobutane; pentane ke teen isomers; carbon barhne se isomers tezi se barhte hain.
